rationale: Kinome-wide Brunello knockout screen in BON-1 GEP-NET cells, day 14 vs day 0 (essential genes depleted). The library was split into two half-pools (sgRNA sets 1-4 = A, 5-8 = B; four guides per gene in each) that were transduced and sequenced as separate libraries with different Day14/Day0 read ratios (0.92 vs 1.07), so each half-pool needs its own library totals. prepare.R puts each guide's counts in its own pool's columns (0 elsewhere) and makes the 100 non-targeting IDs unique per pool; each analysis then uses that pool's totals and 4 guides per gene. One library per time point, so BARCS uses the no-replicate path (overdispersion pooled over 100 non-targeting guides per pool); calls are screening-level.
